instruction.text: Select all the uses of a colon.

b: indicates the end of a sentence

instruction.text: Drag the colon to the correct place in the text.

atoms.a: His room was a sanctuary: filled with soft cushions, warm colours, and lots of character.
atoms.b: His room was a sanctuary((++:)) filled with soft cushions, warm colours, and lots of character.

atoms.a: The assignment is due tomorrow: make sure to submit it before noon.
atoms.b: The assignment is due tomorrow((++:)) make sure to submit it before noon.

atoms.a: He had one goal in mind: to climb the highest peak in the region.
atoms.b: He had one goal in mind((++:)) to climb the highest peak in the region.

atoms.a: Albert Einstein: “Imagination is more important than knowledge.”
atoms.b: Albert Einstein((++:)) “Imagination is more important than knowledge.”

atoms.a: The museum featured a stunning exhibit: Art Through the Ages.
atoms.b: The museum featured a stunning exhibit((++:)) Art Through the Ages.

atoms.b: Maya Angelou((++:)) “If you don’t like something, change it. If you can’t change it, change your attitude.”

atoms.a: I saw something incredible today: two red squirrels in my garden!
atoms.b: I saw something incredible today((:)) two red squirrels in my garden!

atoms.b: I’m stuck on this decision((:)) should I accept the offer or turn it down?
